snippet.title: First Look at the new Horde Defense Strategy Game | Zombies Aren't Real
snippet.description:
🔴Wishlist Zombies Aren't Real on Steam to be notified when it comes out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5185890/Zombies_Arent_Real/

A gameplay first look at Zombies Aren't Real

Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you attempt to control a quick-spreading zombie infection in real-world cities by commanding military forces.

You're given a bird's eye view of a city and shown where the infection will begin, but you have time to plan.  With limited resources, carefully choose how you will respond to the infection and establish a plan to save as many civilians as possible.

Once you're ready the chaos begins. The zombies will fan out and begin to infect the population.  You are able to adapt your plan on the fly.  If the zombies break through your perimeter you can reposition forces on the fly and even call in air support such as bombers or gatling gun helicopters to attempt to stop the spread before it gets out of control.

If you're able to eliminate all the zombies you win and your score is determined by how many civilians you saved.

Eventually you'll gain access to the loadout screen where you can specialize and upgrade your forces for future encounters.
Features

    Play in real-world cities such as New York, Paris, LA, and Venice

    Deploy specialized ground forces against the spreading horde, such as snipers, turrets, mortar squads and garrisons

    Call in air strikes when things get out of hand, but be careful to aim them well to minimize civilian casualties

    Place down barricades and evacuation stations to control the flow of the spreading infection

    Spec into your favorite strategy by investing in upgrades for particular units and vehicles
